description: Half Tide Tug Harbour tide gauge—predicted interval data is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Predicted water level heights at Half Tide Tug Harbour at regular time intervals. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are Half Tide Tug Harbour, msq, predicted interval data, tides. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
